scope.dataset: Only original RAGTruth QA fit634 + calibration159 development answers.
scope.microclaims: Exact label-blind output of atomic_relation_audit_r32_v1 (9,061 fit; 2,268 calibration). Retain seven punctuation-only records in an audit list and score the remaining 9,055 + 2,267 factual microclaims.
scope.windows: Unchanged eligible 4-original-BPE stride-one windows, used only in score stage.
scope.test: Official test paths are absent from this runner and never opened.
scope.expansion_hook: The loader is partition-manifest based; a future 3,680-answer run must use a new output/version and a separately frozen microclaim manifest. It may not be mixed into v1.

hypothesis.split: Remove only a leading discourse/attribution scaffold. For noninitial fragments with a deterministic previous-sibling antecedent, prepend that exact surface subject after removing a leading connector.
hypothesis.labels: No label, score, corpus statistic, or model output affects the transformation.

retrieval.per_passage: Reuse the frozen v1 Unicode-token BM25 implementation and choose top two sentences independently in passage 1, 2 and 3.
retrieval.nli_pairs: Each selected sentence separately plus their in-rank-order concatenation when two sentences exist. Premise=evidence, hypothesis=contextualized microclaim.

nli.reuse: An exact premise+hypothesis pair may reuse a probability from the already frozen v1 cache; all other pairs use the identical frozen checkpoint and numerical path.

features.relation: Label-blind claim flags plus lexical subject/entity/predicate, negation, comparator direction, quantity/unit, temporal direction, condition, and source-specific compatibility with retrieved evidence.
features.whitebox: Optional microclaim pooling of clean fit group-OOF Lookback/large probabilities and frozen generation NLL. Candidate family is selected on fit OOF only.

readout.label: A microclaim is positive iff any lexical original BPE assigned to it has the unchanged human risk label; labels open only in score stage after NLI caches freeze.
readout.crossfit: Five-fold GroupKFold by locked source-connected group supplies every fit microclaim prediction. Full-fit selected model predicts calibration.
readout.weights: Equal source-group mass, then answer mass, then microclaim mass, followed by binary class balance and restored equal group loss mass.
readout.selection: Fit OOF only: maximize minimum(window F1, answer F1), then window F1, answer F1, precision, and simpler candidate order.
readout.projection: Each lexical BPE inherits every microclaim whose alphanumeric characters it overlaps (normally one; a boundary-straddling BPE may map to both). Each unchanged four-BPE window and answer take the maximum overlapping score.
readout.strict: Window and answer thresholds selected on fit OOF and frozen for calibration.
readout.diagnostic: Also report calibration F1-optimal thresholds explicitly as a non-independent common development diagnostic.

baselines: Read-only references only. No baseline file, structure, feature, parameter, threshold, or score is changed.
stage_gate: initialize -> CPU prepare -> CPU check -> explicit GPU smoke -> explicit extraction -> CPU score
